operators.name: RMSNorm

C1_semantic_review.scope: posthoc independent review of this round against the existing original semantic checklist; after 4d closure no other unmet original semantic clause was identified

C1_future_rerun_prerequisites: current guard environment receipt mismatch and unavailable original temporary task paths must be addressed before a new run; they do not invalidate independently reviewed historical numerical data

C1_iteration_scope_decision.decision: STOP: baseline met the original target; supported conditional analysis, candidate feasibility and implementation/regression costs justify ending this round
C1_iteration_scope_decision.basis: original 4b permits skipping 4c when GM(ref/TL)>=0.6; actual standard GM is 3.559312429844659. Original 4d requires a supported engineering decision, not measured removal fractions for a new candidate or proof of a hardware limit.
C1_iteration_scope_decision.conditional_examples_only: Four representative short-row/streamed examples yield about 1.048-1.150x under hypothetical 10%-25% elimination of an assumed wall-time fraction. These are neither measured gains nor a proven achievable range; actual gain may be negative.

limits: quick parser fallback and actual iteration boundaries are not established per case
some older B values were printed to two decimal places
TL standard performance is separate from ASC A/C1 comparison

C1_CPU_existing_profile_review.upper_bound_acceptance_scope: posthoc engineering analysis under original 4d, not proof of a physical upper limit or original native PASS
case42_CPU_evidence: original PMU records, installed tool formulas and database values were cross-checked and independently reviewed
retained traces link 20 iterations to kernels and host launch, but do not expose internal load/compute/store stage boundaries
conditional Amdahl/roofline sensitivity estimates are usable engineering evidence, not proof of exact residual speedup
C1_CPU_existing_profile_review.original_4d_scope: Reasonable stage/pipe estimates and explicit assumptions are allowed. Obtaining every counter unit, an exact official hardware peak or mutually exclusive stages is not a universal additional gate; any adopted numerical inference still needs adequate support.
limitations: separate metric captures do not prove per-iteration alignment or additive algorithm-stage fractions
unknown counter byte granularity or memory level cannot be treated as physical HBM traffic; ideal logical traffic is not a proven HBM lower bound
conditional examples are neither measured candidate gains nor guaranteed improvement ranges; the STOP decision considers the achieved target, supported estimates and implementation/regression costs

pairing_identity_limit: Merged rows and unique case IDs do not independently establish original joins or bitwise-identical inputs; repeated shape/dtype combinations exist. Case identity depends on retained original indexes, which are not fully redistributed.
review_digest_semantics: SHA-256 identifies retained original review bytes, not publicly retrievable original artifacts or proof of full reproducibility
historical_knowledge_reading: material availability and later packaging do not prove per-author reading before generation
Cumsum: paused by user; excluded from this four-operator report
public_data_row_semantics: Sum of rows in six CSV files; Histc and RMSNorm A values repeat between A/B and A/C1 tables. Not 455 distinct test cases.
